purpose: Recover one constant quarter BPM, one constant time signature, and one global audio-relative downbeat offset from audio.

sensor.implementation: Official beat-this 1.1.0 with the final0 checkpoint
sensor.output: 50 Hz beat and downbeat logits; official minimal-postprocessor events retained as baseline
sensor.source_geometry: Original recording and source-time origin preserved; resampling occurs only inside the official sensor preprocessing

candidate_search.broad_search: Beat periodic spectrum and bar periodic spectrum propose neighborhoods in the fixed rational pool; half/double relatives remain actual competitors.
candidate_search.phase_search: Whole-input activation folding supplies phase regions. All possible beat positions within each candidate 3- or 4-beat bar are compared, then leading phases are refined at 2 ms steps.
candidate_search.search_limit: This is a spectral-seeded coarse-to-fine search; it does not exhaust every continuous phase for every rational BPM.
candidate_search.offset_definition: One canonical downbeat position modulo a bar, relative to unchanged input audio zero. No separate anchor or original DAW bar number is estimated.

objective.basis: Whole-input agreement in both grid-to-evidence and evidence-to-grid directions, with one source event per click and one click per source event.
objective.formula: 0.5 beat weighted smooth F1 + 0.4 downbeat weighted smooth F1 + 0.1 mean beat-grid activation - 0.015 timing-residual penalty - 0.015 long-term-drift penalty
objective.confidence: Uncalibrated sensor-agreement diagnostics; absence of a flag is not a correctness certificate.

evaluation.reference: Stored, reviewed audio-relative quarter/downbeat events within catalog support. Evaluation uses these events without another offset, source-clock rebuilding or reference extrapolation.
evaluation.nominal_bpm: Nearest allowed rational representation is display-only; exact stored reference BPM is retained for numerical error.
evaluation.events: One-to-one matching at 10, 20, 30 and 70 ms; common 26-sample macro mean.
evaluation.clock_errors: Pair by the same quarter/bar index to retain accumulated drift; also report matched-event timing conditional on event matching.
evaluation.reference_limit: Listening-reviewed alignment does not independently certify original-click timing at millisecond precision. The cohort is known development material.

comparisons.scoring_ablation: One separately frozen grid-only score removes reverse evidence coverage; original predictions remain unchanged.
comparisons.oracle: After source-only predictions are saved, known reference BPM and meter isolate offset fitting. These results are diagnostic only.
comparisons.historical_constant_grid: Comparable frozen results on the same 26-sample cohort are unavailable.
